verification: Every source file SHA256 is recorded. AWS CLI uploads use end-to-end CRC64NVME checksums; stored full-object CRC and source-SHA metadata are read back. No archived payload is restored or independently downloaded for SHA verification.
limits: Existing shared reference backup is not modified.
File sizes and modification times must match the frozen experiment inventory.
Archive restoration is required before reference reuse.
The failed or completed search status is preserved, never converted into a biological no-hit result.
